capabilities: Cast animated spell areas on Atlas maps
Draw walls, light and magical darkness
Roll D&D 5e attacks, saves and damage
Save and organize spells through Bases
extras: Free and unofficial (not endorsed by Atlas VTT, Atlas Online or JB2A); formerly named Spell Effects for AtlasVTT. Rolling supports D&D 5e/2024 only, though effects work with any game system. Optionally downloads JB2A's ~1.2 GB animation pack from GitHub and works offline afterward. Needs Atlas 0.15+ (for spells as Atlas areas) and Obsidian 1.10+.
intentEvidence: Spells become Atlas's own areas, so your players see them too
problem: Atlas VTT maps have no built-in way to show spell areas, walls, light and darkness, or to roll attacks, saves and damage during tabletop combat.

relations.evidence: Spells, attacks and a bit of flair for your Atlas VTT maps.
JB2A's free pack is built in and picked for you
the Fantasy Statblocks plugin comes with the 5e SRD's creatures

summary: Atlas VTT add-on that casts animated spell areas, walls, light and darkness on maps from statblocks, with optional D&D 5e rolling.
